entities.name: A2SLH5 anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase
observations: Exact 344-aa sequence match to reviewed UniProt A2SLH5 from Methylibium petroleiphilum; annotated as anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase, EC 2.4.2.18.
Catalyzes transfer of phosphoribosyl group from PRPP to anthranilate, producing N-(5'-phosphoribosyl)-anthranilate in tryptophan biosynthesis.
Reference annotation reports two Mg2+ ions per monomer and a homodimer; cytosolic GO annotation.
Sequence-derived: 344 aa, 36,127 Da, theoretical pI 6.18; Pfam Glycos_trans_3N PF02885 and Glycos_transf_3 PF00591.

entities.name: Anthranilate phosphoribosyl transfer
observations: EC 2.4.2.18; Rhea RHEA:11768. Physiological direction: anthranilate + PRPP → N-(5'-phosphoribosyl)-anthranilate + diphosphate.

entities.name: L-tryptophan biosynthesis
observations: Anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase catalyzes step 2 of 5 from chorismate in the annotated tryptophan biosynthesis pathway.
